paper.title: SPARGen: Unifying Spatial Perception and Reasoning through Native Multimodal Generation

coverage.notes: Core mechanisms, equations, main tables, captions, training details, ablations and conclusion are anchored. The supplied 9-page PDF has no separately detected appendix; bibliography entries are retained by source-page anchor rather than translated entry by entry.

claims.claim: SPARGen uses native autoregressive and rectified-flow pathways of a shared MoT backbone for sequence and dense-field spatial outputs.
The model jointly covers depth, point maps, optical flow, pose and spatial reasoning.
Ablations show both transfer between heterogeneous supervision and capacity competition.
